summary: Refine HistGB grid (leaves/lr/l2), confirm best on pilot CV, write cv_auc alone to out/metrics.json
reasoning: Refining round 1 (best lr=0.06, leaves=15, cv 0.8343). I build on pairs trail step-14 (logistic on pairwise products, cv_auc 0.8923, pilot-only), which shows pairwise interactions carry the signal, so larger boosted trees and mild L2 should help my raw-feature booster approximate them. I test leaves {15,31} x lr {0.04,0.06} x l2 {0,1} with the same seed-0 5-fold CV, merge with round-1 results, pick the best on pilot only, recompute its CV inside the same run, and write {cv_auc} alone to out/metrics.json so the boost-cv milestone registers. Expect the best config at cv_auc >= 0.83; the milestone gate is 0.80.
